_cuts: S1 conv encoder (bp -> 128bp tokens) | S2 transformer tower (sequence -> pair inside it) | S3 128bp + pair output embeddings | S4 U-Net decoder back to 1bp + 1bp embedding | S5 per-assay track heads (each head emits BOTH 1bp and 128bp, so heads do not split by resolution) | S6 pair -> contact maps | S7 splice heads (1bp)
_interleaved: tower.blocks.{0,2,4,6,8}.pair_update runs on even blocks only, inside S2. Time as a sub-stage (sum of 5 calls) or fold into S2: decide in Block 2.
_glue: ops made by AlphaGenome.forward() itself between child calls (root). Harness reports glue = end-to-end - sum(stages).
